name: Quang Dong Assembly Hall
summary: Walk into the Quang Dong assembly hall at 22 Hang Buom, the tiled gatehouse on the street. The ticket is 20,000 VND a visit. Day hours are 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30, and Friday to Sunday the hall opens again at 19:00, closing at 21:00 or 21:30. Children under 16 go free, and 23 November is free. Come for the hall, not for a shop on the pavement.
heroCaption: The tiled gatehouse of Quang Dong Assembly Hall on Hang Buom
gettingThere: The hall is at 22 Hang Buom, in the lanes north of Hoan Kiem Lake. Walk north from the lake to Hang Buom.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem Lake
legs.body: On foot, north into the lanes to 22 Hang Buom.

hours: 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30. Friday–Sunday evening from 19:00, closing at 21:00 or 21:30.
closed: Check on arrival. Free on 23 November.
admissionNote: 20,000 VND a visit. The charge starts on 1 January 2025, on 2 January 2025, and on 19 January 2025. Children under 16 are free. Severe disability is free, and heavy disability is also free. A 50 percent reduction covers older visitors and students from 16, and also disabled visitors and visitors on a cultural concession. Free on 23 November.
